verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is a terminal-based AI coding agent, so inline completions are a fair question for a coding tool, but the evidence pack never documents as-you-type inline code completions or next-edit suggestions. The `@` filename autocomplete for attaching paths to messages is an adjacent feature, not code completion, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
